svg.title: Booking platform: who runs what
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 8 components and 7 connections in 2 boundaries. Cloud account: API gateway, Booking service, Pricing service, Data zone. Data zone (in Cloud account): Bookings, Legacy inventory. Most connected: Booking service (5 connections). Nothing leads into Guest. Bottleneck: API gateway; without it the diagram falls apart. Guest (person): connects to Booking app (books). Booking app (frontend): connects to API gateway (via HTTPS). API gateway (service): connects to Booking service (routes). Booking service (service): connects to Pricing service (asks price), Bookings (via SQL), Legacy inventory (checks rooms) and Payment provider (charges, via HTTPS). Pricing service (service): no outgoing connection. Bookings (database): no outgoing connection. Legacy inventory (database): no outgoing connection. Payment provider (external system): no outgoing connection. Perspective Team: Storefront: Booking app; Bookings: Booking service, Pricing service; Platform: API gateway, Bookings, Legacy inventory; not stated: Guest, Payment provider. The team named in the service catalogue runs each component.

polyline.title: Booking service → Pricing service: asks price
Booking service → Legacy inventory: checks rooms
